title: Statehood
description: Colorado achieved statehood 1876 (38th). The road to statehood ran through territorial government, population thresholds, and a congressional enabling act — the standard American path. Statehood in centennial year 1876. Statehood Day is still celebrated, and the admission order gives Colorado its number among the states.
